evidence_note: Oracle confirmed it cut 21,000 employees in 2026, with reports saying AI replaced some roles. This substantiates the rumored layoff concerns.

CNA and The Straits Times confirm StanChart's plan to cut over 7,000 jobs globally (up to almost 8,000) due to AI, replacing 'lower-value human capital' roles. No specific Singapore headcount was disclosed.

eFinancialCareers reported on Jul 16, 2026 that Citi has quietly cut 7,000 jobs this year, confirming that the CEO's planned deeper job cuts are actively underway. This aligns with the original rumor, though no specific Singapore headcount is cited.
HSBC has implemented significant job cuts, including cutting one in 10 senior bankers globally, confirming the rumored deep cuts. Financial Times also reported HSBC spent $68mn on the cull.
Follow-up reporting confirms HSBC has actually carried out significant job cuts, including the biggest cull of senior bankers since 2010, substantiating the rumored layoff event.

Follow-up reporting confirmed that HSBC cut dozens of investment banking roles in Asia in February 2025, including 40 dealmakers in Hong Kong, substantiating the rumored plans for a new round of investment bank job cuts. No Singapore-specific headcount was provided.
Follow-up reporting confirms HSBC's planned senior role cuts materialized, with the bank clearing out senior bankers in its largest cull since 2010.

Reuters and other major outlets confirm Morgan Stanley laid off 2,500 employees globally in March 2026, corroborating the earlier rumored workforce reduction. The Singapore-specific headcount was not disclosed in the available evidence.

Follow-up reporting confirms KPMG is cutting jobs in Australia, the UK, and the US, but no Singapore-specific layoffs have been confirmed. The rumored impact on Singapore remains unconfirmed.

Follow-up reporting confirms Curly's will close on June 22 and be replaced by a new eatery, but does not explicitly confirm that existing staff will be laid off; the impact on jobs remains unconfirmed.
The Straits Times confirms Carnivore Brazilian Churrascaria will close in September 2026 after 20 years, substantiating the planned closure and job losses.

Follow-up articles from Mothership, AsiaOne, and VnExpress confirm the restaurant's announcement of a planned closure in September 2026, but the closure has not yet occurred and no job cuts have been confirmed as executed.

Crisil has extended the timeline for closure of Coalition Singapore to July 2027, indicating the planned layoff remains anticipated but not yet confirmed. No evidence of actual job cuts or denial was found.
The Business Times confirms Metro will close its department stores in Paragon and Causeway Point after leases expire, validating the rumored closures. No specific headcount is provided.

The Cincinnati Enquirer reports that P&G's job reduction program is on track, with 3,500 of the 7,000 planned cuts completed a year into the restructuring, confirming the layoffs are actively underway. The Singapore-specific headcount remains unconfirmed in this follow-up.

Disney confirmed it is cutting 1,000 jobs globally under its new CEO, with Business Times reporting the eliminations on April 14, 2026. No specific Singapore headcount was confirmed, so the earlier ~50 estimate remains unverified.
